mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fx_jst_order_out (o_id, so_id, express_name, express, express_code, is_tran) VALUES (#{oId}, #{soId}, #{expressName}, #{express}, #{expressCode}, #{isTran}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE so_id = VALUES(so_id), express_name = VALUES(express_name), express = VALUES(express), express_code = VALUES(express_code), is_tran = VALUES(is_tran)
mapper.select: SELECT t.so_id, t.express_name, t.express_code, IF(t.express IS NULL OR t.express = '', CONCAT('NO_EXPRESSNO', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d')), t.express) AS express, t.o_id, e.so_from, e.receiver_name FROM fx_jst_order_out t LEFT JOIN fx_ec2jst_order e ON e.order_no = t.so_id WHERE t.is_tran = 0 GROUP BY t.so_id, t.express_name, t.express_code, t.express, t.o_id, e.so_from, e.receiver_name
SELECT T.SO_ID, T.express_name, T.express FROM fx_jst_order_out T WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fx_import_order C WHERE C.SO_ID = T.SO_ID AND C.is_shipped = 0)
